name: coal-to-power
title: Coal to electric power loop
description: An offshore pump, a boiler and three steam engines on the nearest shore, wired along a pole line, with the boiler loaded with coal. Roughly 2.7 MW once it is burning.

anchor.describe: a stretch of shore an offshore pump will fit on

coal.description: coal to load into the boiler

steps.message: Found a shore. Building a coal power block -- shout if it is in the way.
Power block is up and burning. Run a pole line from it when you want it.
